/**
 * DEMO DATA — design prototype only.
 * ----------------------------------
 * These values are illustrative and NOT verified measurements.
 * Every surface that renders them must carry the demo-data label.
 *
 * To replace with real data: export canopy series from Google Earth
 * Engine (see /docs/google-earth-engine-integration.md and
 * /data/import/), then regenerate this file — or import the JSON
 * directly — keeping the LocalityRecord shape intact.
 */

import type { CanopyYear, DatasetMeta, LocalityRecord } from "./treeScoreSchema";

export const demoDatasetMeta: DatasetMeta = {
  source: "demo",
  label: "Demo data for design prototype",
  generatedOn: "2026-06-12",
};

/** Years rendered across the product. */
export const SERIES_YEARS = [2016, 2018, 2020, 2022, 2024, 2026] as const;

/**
 * Builds a plausible, smoothly-declining demo series ending at the
 * locality's current canopy percentage and spanning its 2016 trend.
 * Demo-only convenience — real series come from satellite composites.
 */
function demoSeries(currentPercent: number, trendSince2016: number): CanopyYear[] {
  const start = currentPercent - trendSince2016;
  const steps = SERIES_YEARS.length - 1;
  return SERIES_YEARS.map((year, i) => {
    // Ease-out curve: faster early change, settling toward today.
    const t = i / steps;
    const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 1.6);
    const value = start + (currentPercent - start) * eased;
    return { year, canopyPercent: Math.round(value * 10) / 10 };
  });
}

/** All demo localities, with historical series filled in. */
export const demoLocalities: LocalityRecord[] = seeds.map((seed) => ({
  ...seed,
  years: seed.years ?? demoSeries(seed.canopyPercent, seed.trendSince2016),
}));
